2124241403559498166.en_summary: (Reposted by @JonkooTrades) $SPCX - Morgan Stanley concludes a single Starship launch with Starlink V3 pays back variable cost in about 19 weeks of operating profit, less than half the time for SpaceX's AI compute business. Keeps Overweight rating and $300 price target, more than double current. Full payload 50 Tbps gross, 2.5 Tbps salable. V3 satellites 10x downlink of V2 Mini. Starship launch 20-25x bandwidth of Falcon 9. Expects Starship to cut variable launch cost from $1,000/kg in 2026 to $500 by 2030 and $140 by 2040, weekly launches by end 2027. At ~$140 stock is 4% above $135 offer, estimates risen. Holy bullish.
2124241403559498166.zh_summary: （由 @JonkooTrades 轉發）$SPCX - 摩根士丹利得出結論，單次星艦發射攜帶 Starlink V3 衛星約在 19 週運營利潤內回收變動成本，少於 SpaceX AI 計算業務時間的一半。維持超配評級和 300 美元目標價，超過當前價格一倍以上。全載荷 50 Tbps 總容量，2.5 Tbps 可售。V3 衛星下行容量是 V2 Mini 的 10 倍。星艦發射帶寬是獵鷹 9 的 20-25 倍。預期星艦將變動發射成本從 2026 年每公斤 1000 美元降至 2030 年 500 美元和 2040 年 140 美元，2027 年底每週發射。約 140 美元的股票比 135 美元發行價高 4%，估計已上升。非常看好。
